name: Global Mixed-Mode Technology Inc.
summary: Global Mixed-Mode Technology Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, manufacturing, and sale of digital and analog mixed-signal integrated circuits in Taiwan, China, South Korea, and internationally. The company offers DC-DC products, including VCM driver, synchronous step down converter and controller, switching charger, step up converter, pre gate driver and DrMOSFET, point of load, PMIC, photoflash charger, panel PMIC, motor driver, linear charger, lighting driver, LED backlight driver, charge pump and current source, and auto buck-boost converter; analog switch; and amplifier, such as operational amplifier, level shifter, integrated buffer,…
